bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/admin1/projects/webhook-gateway
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib, secrets, subprocess, tempfile, time
p=pathlib.Path('.env')
if not p.is_file(): raise SystemExit('MISSING_GATEWAY_ENV')
orig=p.read_bytes()
lines=orig.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
found=[i for i,v in enumerate(lines) if v.startswith('INTERNAL_EVENT_API_PROJECT_KEYS_JSON=')]
if len(found)!=1: raise SystemExit('PROJECT_KEY_ENTRY_COUNT_INVALID')
raw=lines[found[0]].split('=',1)[1].strip()
try: keys=json.loads(raw.strip("'\""))
except Exception: raise SystemExit('PROJECT_KEY_JSON_INVALID')
if not isinstance(keys,dict) or not keys.get('server-core'): raise SystemExit('SERVERCORE_EXISTING_KEY_MISSING')
if keys.get('tgserver'): raise SystemExit('TGSERVER_ALREADY_CONFIGURED_ABORT_NO_ROTATION')
if subprocess.run(['gh','auth','status'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode: raise SystemExit('GH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE')
if subprocess.run(['gh','api','repos/seigo-gace/TGserver','--jq','.permissions.admin'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()!='true': raise SystemExit('GH_REPO_WRITE_NOT_CONFIRMED')
key=secrets.token_hex(32)
keys['tgserver']=key
payload=json.dumps(keys,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
lines[found[0]]="INTERNAL_EVENT_API_PROJECT_KEYS_JSON='"+payload+"'\n"
updated=''.join(lines).encode()
backup=pathlib.Path('.env.tgserver-key-before-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ',time.gmtime()))
fd=os.open(backup,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f: f.write(orig); f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
def restore():
 t=p.with_name('.env.tgserver-key-rollback-temp')
 t.write_bytes(orig);os.chmod(t,0o600);os.replace(t,p)
 subprocess.run(['docker','compose','up','-d','--no-deps','--force-recreate','api'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=140)
def check_healthy():
 for _ in range(55):
  z=subprocess.run(['docker','inspect','-f','{{.State.Health.Status}}','webhook-gateway-api-1'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if z.returncode==0 and z.stdout.strip()=='healthy': return True
  time.sleep(2)
 return False
try:
 t=p.with_name('.env.tgserver-key-change-temp'); t.write_bytes(updated);os.chmod(t,0o600);os.replace(t,p)
 subprocess.run(['docker','compose','up','-d','--no-deps','--force-recreate','api'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=140)
 if not check_healthy(): raise RuntimeError('API_HEALTH_NOT_READY')
 r=subprocess.run(['gh','secret','set','DEVLOG_GATEWAY_TOKEN','--repo','seigo-gace/TGserver'],input=key+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
 if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('GH_SECRET_UPDATE_FAILED')
 print('PROJECT_KEY_TGSERVER_REGISTERED=PASS')
 print('SERVERCORE_EXISTING_KEY_PRESERVED=PASS')
 print('GATEWAY_LEGACY_AUTH_PRESERVED=PASS')
 print('GATEWAY_API_HEALTH=PASS')
 print('TGSERVER_ACTION_SECRET_UPDATED=PASS')
 print('BACKUP_FILE='+str(backup))
except Exception as ex:
 print('MIGRATION_FAILED='+type(ex).__name__+':'+str(ex))
 restore()
 print('GATEWAY_CONFIG_ROLLED_BACK=PASS')
 raise SystemExit(2)
PY
